 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u098/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d594599f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two grids separated by a solid marker line."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A full, uniform, nonzero row separates vertically stacked grids.
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                if row and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    # A full, uniform, nonzero column separates horizontally adjacent grids.
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w)
                if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    if row_seps:
        s = min(row_seps, key=lambda r: abs(r - (h - 1) / 2))
        top, bottom = grid[:s], grid[s + 1:]
        height = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        width = min(len(top[0]), len(bottom[0]))
        return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
    if col_seps:
        s = min(col_seps, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
        left, right = [row[:s] for row in grid], [row[s + 1:] for row in grid]
        height = min(len(left), len(right))
        width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
    raise ValueError('No solid separator line found')
"
}
